verdict.rationale: The Web API documents `$batch` requests that group multiple operations into a single HTTP request, optionally as an atomic change set. That is a real programmatic way to act on many records at once. However, the evidence covers only API-level batching, not bulk operations as a user-facing capability. Missing for 10: in-app bulk edit/assign/delete of many records, documented batch size or scale limits, Copilot/agent-driven bulk actions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Group multiple operations into a single HTTP request, optionally within a change set to ensure they succeed or fail as a unit.
By sending a `GET` request within a `$batch`, you can use URLs up to 64 KB (65,536 characters) in length.
